label: Из
description: Source and exit sentences that teach coming out of places, materials, and origins.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Source/origin. 1. 'Из дома' means from the house. 2. The phrase expresses where you came from. 3. It contrasts directly with 'я в доме'.
Strategic focus: Motion away from a source. 1. 'Иду' is walking motion. 2. 'Из дома' marks departure from the house. 3. This sentence is a core contrast with 'я иду в дом'.
Strategic focus: Origin of a person. 1. 'Из города' tells where he is from. 2. The phrase is short and common. 3. This is useful for describing background and hometown.
Strategic focus: Arrival from a source. 1. 'Приехал' is vehicle-based motion. 2. 'Из города' marks the source. 3. This sentence is a practical travel pattern.
Strategic focus: Something coming from a container. 1. 'Из стакана' marks the source container. 2. The sentence is concrete and easy to picture. 3. It helps learners feel source versus location.
Strategic focus: Source plus action. 1. 'Беру' is the action verb. 2. 'Из стакана' marks where the water comes from. 3. This sentence is useful for everyday physical action.
Strategic focus: Exit from a place. 1. 'Вышли' is completed motion out of somewhere. 2. 'Из дома' marks the source. 3. This is one of the most important departure patterns.
Strategic focus: Leaving a location on foot. 1. 'Идем' is plural walking motion. 2. 'Из школы' marks departure. 3. The sentence contrasts strongly with 'мы идем в школу'.
Strategic focus: Removing an object from a container. 1. 'Достала' is a completed action. 2. 'Из сумки' marks the source container. 3. The sentence is highly practical and vivid.
Strategic focus: Ongoing removal from a pocket. 1. 'Достаю' is present tense. 2. 'Из кармана' marks the source. 3. This is a very modern everyday sentence.
Strategic focus: Returning from a store. 1. 'Пришли' is plural past motion. 2. 'Из магазина' marks the source. 3. This sentence is a strong source-versus-destination contrast with 'в магазин'.
Strategic focus: Leaving a room. 1. 'Вышли' marks movement out. 2. 'Из комнаты' is the source. 3. This is a very common household and narrative phrase.
Strategic focus: Extracting something from a drawer. 1. 'Вынул' is a strong completed action verb. 2. 'Из ящика' marks the source. 3. The sentence is vivid and easy to imagine.
Strategic focus: Source of sound. 1. 'Из окна' marks where the noise comes from. 2. 'Слышу' is a perception verb. 3. This sentence shows that source phrases work with more than just physical objects.
Strategic focus: Remote communication source. 1. 'Из дома' marks where the writing is happening. 2. 'Пишет' is a common present tense verb. 3. This is useful in modern remote-work contexts.
Strategic focus: Source of an action. 1. 'Из машины' marks the location from which the call happens. 2. 'Звоним' is plural present. 3. This sentence is natural and very useful.
Strategic focus: Cause source. 1. 'Из-за тебя' expresses cause or reason. 2. 'Сделал' is past tense. 3. This sentence adds a slightly more advanced source-like meaning.

Strategic focus: Cause source with object pronoun. 1. 'Из-за него' marks the reason. 2. 'Сделал' keeps the sentence simple. 3. This is useful for seeing how source/cause phrases can attach to pronouns.
Strategic focus: Departing from a central place. 1. 'Из центра' is a clear source phrase. 2. 'Идем' is plural motion. 3. The sentence nicely complements 'в центр'.
Strategic focus: Exiting from transport. 1. 'Из поезда' marks source from the train. 2. 'Вышли' is the completed motion verb. 3. This is a very practical travel sentence.
